svg.title: Mission Control Center – 3D perspective illustration
svg.desc: A cinematic mission control room in deep perspective. A massive tiled display wall dominates the back, showing a world map, orbital tracks, and telemetry readouts lit in cyan, amber and green. Four tiered rows of operator consoles face the screen. The ceiling has industrial light rigs and cable trays. Side walls carry status boards. The floor is dark with amber caution markings.
